product_one_liner.value: Luminance is an AI contract-intelligence platform that helps enterprise legal, procurement, finance and sales teams analyze, negotiate and automate contracts.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer; the /pricing URL returned no public pricing page. The site directs prospects to request a demo.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 417 employees and a company-size band of 201–500.

hq_location.notes: The current company profile identifies Cambridge as headquarters; an older company blog instead calls London its headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts by Luc Frachon and the Luminance Evals Team (2026-10-05) and Mael Jullien and the Luminance R&D Team (2026-10-14) explain model evaluation, task routing, specialist subagents and validation.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation portal exposes separate documentation for API versions 1.3.0, 1.4.0 and 1.5.0.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The AI Engineer posting in Cambridge is readable and includes an application section.

model_provider.value: Luminance Luna Crescent; OpenAI. AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud EMEA Limited provide in-cloud additional generative-model processing.
model_provider.notes: Luna Crescent is its proprietary contract-specific model. The subprocessor list names OpenAI for additional generative-model processing via API, and AWS, Azure and Google Cloud for in-cloud additional generative-model processing; the cloud providers are infrastructure providers, not necessarily the underlying model developers.

compliance_certs.notes: Completed certification/assurance claims only; GDPR legal references are not treated as a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified round was announced on 2025-02-18, before the 2025-05-09–2026-11-09 window; no later round was located.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Mid-Market Account Executive posting in San Francisco, dated 2026-10-22.

launched_6mo.notes: Luna Crescent, its first proprietary Luna model, was announced on 2026-06-19, inside the 2026-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Don Riddick was appointed Chief Legal Officer on 2026-09-29, inside the 2025-11-09–2026-11-09 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Publicly documented CRM integrations, not proof of internal CRM deployment: the company blog names Salesforce, and its VP of Client Solutions describes Salesforce and HubSpot connectivity.
